answer: Photothermal gas cell refraction tomography binds identities to unique trace-gas envelopes. An agent seals a sealed micro-cavity vault and pulses an infrared laser across it. Simulating 10,000 deceptive profiles demands continuous computation costing 48,000 GPU core-hours and $720,000 in dedicated hardware. This validation acts like tracking a jet engine through its distinct thermal exhaust plume.
